channel.title: Pier & Point · The Exchange on 16th
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for The Exchange on 16th (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · The Exchange on 16th: The earlier row (2026-09-24) says the registration was in April…
item.description: The earlier row (2026-09-24) says the registration was in April 2022 "when its sublease there became a direct lease". DataSF Registered Business Locations: Vir Biotechnology, Inc., 1800 Owens St, location start 2022-04-25. The Real Deal (2022-05-18) is cited for the conversion and returned 403 so was not re-read; the audit found it gives only its publication date, not the conversion date. The two events are not shown to coincide. The earlier row is left as written. Source: https://data.sfgov.org/Economy-and-Community/Registered-Business-Locations-San-Francisco/g8m3-pdis.

item.description: The summary for The Exchange on 16th now includes 2026 report of an OpenAI sublease. Source: https://therealdeal.com/san-francisco/2026/03/16/openai-inks-another-mission-bay-lease/.

item.title: Correction · The Exchange on 16th: Dropbox is still listed at 1800 Owens St, but The Real Deal…
item.description: Dropbox is still listed at 1800 Owens St, but The Real Deal reported on March 16, 2026 that it is planning to vacate the building entirely, and Hoodline reported on April 16, 2026 that it is taking a whole building at 50 Hawthorne St for its new headquarters. DataSF still shows a Dropbox registration at 1800 Owens St with no end date and a new one at 50 Hawthorne St from July 2026. No source read says the move is complete. Source: https://therealdeal.com/san-francisco/2026/03/16/openai-inks-another-mission-bay-lease/; https://hoodline.com/2026/04/dropbox-nabs-full-south-fidi-tower-as-decagon-muscles-into-soma/.

item.title: Correction · The Exchange on 16th: The Exchange on 16th page no longer says the whole campus is…
item.description: The Exchange on 16th page no longer says the whole campus is leased to Dropbox: the 2017 lease covered the 736,000 sq ft of office space, not the retail space, and The Real Deal reported in March 2026 that Dropbox is planning to vacate. Source: Allen Matkins, 'Allen Matkins represents Kilroy in largest lease in SF history' (11.16.17, allenmatkins.com/real-ideas/allen-matkins-represents-kilroy-in-largest-lease-in-sf-history.html); Kilroy Realty Q3 2017 supplemental (SEC Ex. 99.2).

item.title: Correction · The Exchange on 16th: The Exchange on 16th no longer shows a completion year
item.description: The Exchange on 16th no longer shows a completion year. The Real Deal (May 2022) says Kilroy completed it in 2018, while a city permit closed on September 19, 2019 and the record's open questions cite Kilroy reports of 2019 deliveries. The September 2015 groundbreaking ceremony is shown as a ceremony only; the city issued the building permit on November 12, 2015. The OpenAI lease entry no longer lists 'Unit 1-4', which no source gives. Source: The Real Deal, 2022-05-18; The Registry, 2015-09-04; DataSF Building Permits i98e-djp9, permit 201409045458; The Real Deal, 2026-03-16.

item.title: Correction · The Exchange on 16th: Dropbox, Vir and OpenAI were previously each said to have…
item.description: Dropbox, Vir and OpenAI were previously each said to have opened an office on the date of a DataSF business registration; a registration is not an opening, so these tenants no longer carry an opened date. Vir now cites its own contact page (1800 Owens Street, Suite 900) and Dropbox cites the March 2026 Real Deal report that it plans to vacate; OpenAI is now shown as announced, based on the reported ~280,000 sq ft sublease (March 2026). The Exchange on 16th's completion moved from January 2018 to 2018 (Kilroy's own release has Dropbox taking possession in phases from Q4 2018), the groundbreaking is dated September 2015 and cited to a readable report, the lot is about 3.25 acres, and the lab conversion and OpenAI sublease dates are stated as the sources give them. Source: The Real Deal, 2026-03-16 (https://therealdeal.com/san-francisco/2026/03/16/openai-inks-another-mission-bay-lease/); Vir Biotechnology, contact page (https://www.vir.bio/contact/); Kilroy Realty Q3 2017 supplemental, SEC (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001025996/000102599617000189/exhibit992q317.htm); The Registry SF, Kilroy Realty breaks ground on The Exchange on 16th (https://news.theregistrysf.com/kilroy-realty-breaks-ground-on-the-exchange-on-16th-in-the-mission-bay-submarket-of-san-francisco/); The Real Deal, 2022-05-18 (https://therealdeal.com/san-francisco/2022/05/18/former-dropbox-hq-in-mission-bay-turned-into-750k-sf-of-life-sciences-labs/); DataSF Assessor Historical Secured Property Tax Rolls (wv5m-vpq2).

item.title: Added · The Exchange on 16th: Dropbox registered at 1800 Owens St with a location start date of…
item.description: Dropbox registered at 1800 Owens St with a location start date of 2019-05-30 (DataSF Registered Business Locations); a registration is not an opening. The Real Deal (2026-03-16) reports Dropbox is now planning to vacate the building entirely. Source: https://data.sfgov.org/Economy-and-Community/Registered-Business-Locations-San-Francisco/g8m3-pdis.

item.title: Added · The Exchange on 16th: Vir Biotechnology, Inc. registered at 1800 Owens St with a location…
item.description: Vir Biotechnology, Inc. registered at 1800 Owens St with a location start date of 2022-04-25 (DataSF Registered Business Locations); a registration is not an opening. The Real Deal (2022-05-18) reports Vir's 133,000 sq ft sublease was converted into a direct long-term lease, and Vir's own contact page lists 1800 Owens Street, Suite 900. Source: https://data.sfgov.org/Economy-and-Community/Registered-Business-Locations-San-Francisco/g8m3-pdis.

item.title: Added · The Exchange on 16th: OpenAI signed a deal to sublease approximately 280,000 square feet…
item.description: OpenAI signed a deal to sublease approximately 280,000 square feet of office space at 1800 Owens St, reported by The Real Deal on 2026-03-16 with confirmation from a March 2026 Newmark market report. DataSF Registered Business Locations also lists Openai Opco, LLC at 1800 Owens St Unit 1-4 (location start 2026-06-15) and several 'Bon Appetit @ Openai' catering registrations on floors 2, 3, 6, 7 and 8; registrations do not show an opening. Source: https://therealdeal.com/san-francisco/2026/03/16/openai-inks-another-mission-bay-lease/.

item.description: The Exchange on 16th (1800 Owens St): DataSF shows the new-construction permit (201409045458) completed on 2019-09-19, a permit closeout and not an opening date; The Real Deal (May 18, 2022) says the development was 'completed by Kilroy in 2018', so sources give different completion years and none is shown here as the completion (Sep 19, 2019).
